name: reign
description: A voxel strategy board game inspired by Catan that runs in the browser. Settle, trade and build on a 3D island with friends or bots. Play the classic rules or Reign Extended, with characters and powers, an events deck, new buildings and random maps for up to 8 players.

paragraphs: Settle, trade and build on a hand-crafted voxel island, right in your browser.
English · Русский · 简体中文 · Deutsch · Français

Reign is a multiplayer take on the classic settle-trade-build board game, built from micro-voxels and played in the browser. Every tile, piece, die, card pile and the cozy room around the table is made of tiny voxels and meshed at runtime. Play the full classic game with friends or bots, or switch to Reign Extended for characters with powers, an events deck, new buildings and islands of any shape and size.
features: 🎲 The complete base game. Random 19-tile island with harbors, snake-draft setup, dice
production, the robber, development cards, Longest Road and Largest Army, bank, harbor and player-to-player trades, first to 10 points.
🧱 A living voxel world. Swaying crops, grazing sheep, foamy shallows, rolling physical dice,
cards that fly from the tiles to your hand, and a warm tavern room around the table.
🏰 Reign Extended. 16 characters with traits and powers, a character draft, 13 event cards,
